{{Quote|He has caused much suffering, Master Windu.''"<br />"''As you wish. Zeta Squadron, boost my position. Siri, you stay behind with Adi.''"<br />"''I will, Master Windu.|Adi Gallia, Mace Windu and Siri Tachi|<ref name="JSF" />}}
'''Zeta Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of Zeta Squadron flew [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]. The known members of Zeta Squadron included [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]], [[Empatojayos Brand]], [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]], [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], [[Rana]], [[Ranik Solusar]], [[Jaizen Suel]], and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]].<ref name="JSF" />
